name: bayou
description: Bayou Blockade toolkit: permit-application interrogation pipeline, public-comment drafting for permits, rulemakings, and bond/TEFRA financing hearings, and hearing prep/debrief, plus Louisiana/federal environmental-justice research skills (LDEQ EDMS, EPA ECHO/CAMPD, PACER/CourtListener, OSHA, PHMSA, USACE, FEMA NFHL, CPRA, EPA TRI/FRS crosswalk/GHGRP/RCRA Biennial Report, TRI release reports and campaign charts (facility history and radius cumulative burden with proposed emissions), comparable-facility emissions benchmarks for repermits (same-SIC/NAICS peers sized by CO2e and capacity), forensic wind history, public air monitor lookup (PurpleAir/OpenAQ/AirNow) with Louisiana CAMRA usage guardrails, Federal Register and regulations.gov dockets (MARAD deepwater ports, USCG waterway suitability assessments), USGS/NOAA water data, EJScreen, LA comment calendar, LDEQ permit status, LA species/cultural resource review, unmarked burial site documentary screening, historic topo/lidar and newspaper archive research, multi-sheet permit drawing navigation, multi-backend document OCR with cross-reader agreement (Surya/olmOCR/Chandra/MinerU/Azure) and evidence-backed OCR verification/validation (ocr-verify, ocr-validate), Kit.com campaign-email dissemination (draft-only by default), Nextdoor social campaign generation, SONRIS session/operator/well/document lookup and download (Louisiana DNR oil-and-gas, injection-well, and Class VI carbon-sequestration records, CAPTCHA-gated), Louisiana Class VI/CCS program tracker, chemical hazard profiles (PubChem GHS/IARC, EPA CompTox), Louisiana Public Records Act request drafting, State Bond Commission / LPFA / port and parish IDB bond dockets and outcomes, Louisiana Supreme Court and Court of Appeal opinion search and case-citation verification (First Circuit LDEQ permit appeals, writ history, DAL hearing docket), parish assessor parcels, owners and zoning with edge-to-edge fenceline-to-home distances (St. Charles, Ascension, St. James), LDEQ ERIC state emissions inventory (annual criteria/TAP by AI, release-point actual and permitted rates), EPA RMP (CAA 112(r)) chemical inventories by process, prevention programs, emergency response and all-time accident history from the FOIA'd RMP database, National Response Center spill reports (1990 to date) and CSB investigations, recommendations and 40 CFR 1604 accidental release events, Louisiana lobbyist and campaign-contribution lookup, FERC eLibrary dockets (pipeline and LNG certificates, EIS volumes, orders, comment and intervention notices, intervention movants), parish council and planning/zoning agendas, minutes and keyword alerts for rezonings, special uses, road and servitude actions and inducement/PILOT/CEA items (St. Charles Legistar, Ascension CivicClerk, East Baton Rouge, Plaquemines, St. Bernard and St. James/Assumption OCR via CivicPlus), state water-bottom claims, state mineral leases and SMEB CO2 storage operating agreements with Class VI area-of-review overlap, LDH public drinking-water systems with public-supply wells near an injection well and intakes downstream of an outfall against LDEQ SWAP protection areas, archived EarthScope infrasound and seismic low-frequency spectra with before/after peak comparison and infrasound-seismic coherence, and more).
